bullets.note:
\-- Hilarious fact: I didn’t learn to swim properly until in my 30’s. I found
an earlier model of these when I first learned to swim using the Total
Immersion method ([my cliff notes
here](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=wS7&mc=e&s=bomwH&u=w&y=V&);
my [TV episode on
this](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=wSo&mc=e&s=bomwH&u=w&y=J&)
after a lifetime of water phobia). These are my newest pair.
